map.如何使用太空射击？: How do I use Space Shooter?

map.驾驶飞船消灭敌人，收集道具，挑战最高分！: Pilot your ship to destroy enemies, grab power-ups, and chase the high score!
map.：桌面端使用 ← → 方向键移动，空格键射击，P 键暂停。移动端使用下方虚拟按钮: : on desktop use the left/right arrow keys to move, Space to fire, P to pause; on mobile use the on-screen buttons.
map.太空射击是一款经典的纵向射击游戏。驾驶你的太空飞船，在浩瀚的星空中消灭一波又一波: Space Shooter is a classic vertical shooter. Pilot your ship through the starfield and wipe out wave after wave of alien enemies!
map.三种敌人类型：普通、快速、强壮: Three enemy types: normal, fast, tough
map.三种道具：三连射、护盾、加命: Three power-ups: triple shot, shield, extra life
map.敌人到达底部或碰撞玩家减命: Enemies reaching the bottom or colliding cost a life
map.每500分升一级，难度递增: Level up every 500 points, rising difficulty
map.3条命用完游戏结束: Game over when all 3 lives are gone
map.刷新最高分攀比: Beat and refresh the high score
map.演示碰撞检测与对象池: Demonstrates collision detection and object pooling
map.飞船左右移动并发射子弹，敌机按波次从顶部出现；子弹命中敌机得分，漏过或相撞扣血，: The ship moves left/right and fires; enemy craft appear in waves from the top; bullets hit them for points, while misses or collisions cost health, ending at zero health.
map.第 1 波 5 架敌机各 10 分，全清得 50 分；吃加速道具后射速翻倍，第: Wave 1: 5 enemies at 10 each = 50; after a speed power-up fire rate doubles, wave 2: 8 enemies at 15 each = 120, total 170 and a new high. Scores are stored locally only.
map.最高分存浏览器本地，不联网、不上传；清缓存会重置。: The high score is stored in the browser locally—no network, no upload; clearing cache resets it.
map.降低画质/关闭特效或换设备；游戏纯前端 Canvas 渲染，性能取决于浏览器与硬: Lower quality / turn off effects or use another device; the game is pure-frontend Canvas, so performance depends on the browser and hardware.
